speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent use of levofloxacin for pneumonia, we are highly suspicious for antibiotic-associated colitis, possibly caused by *Clostridioides difficile*. Have you noticed any foul-smelling stools or a sensation of rectal urgency? REQUEST TEST: C. diff toxin assay.
